FOLLOW A MATCH

Features at the selected cell

These are features from the target SAE, ranked by Spearman correlation with the reference feature’s activations on the same images. The map combines independent-SAE matches with the original SAE’s fixed readout, so its score can be higher than the matches below. Opening a card makes that feature the new reference.

What am I looking at?

A feature belongs to a specific SAE at a specific epoch and layer. Its evolution map asks how similarly that feature activates across the training grid. The colour is the maximum of the best independent-SAE match and the original SAE’s fixed readout. A fixed readout retains the original feature’s identity; it is not a feature ID in the target SAE.

Activating images come from the selected reference’s evaluation split and use the repository’s encode() output. Matching is directional: opening a neighbour computes the view from that new reference. A high score suggests similar activation profiles; it does not guarantee a shared semantic concept.

Feature Evolution and Migration during Vision Transformer Training Järve, Aysel, Khajuria & Kull · CIKM 2026
